subject.title: Carry provider-authoritative agent identity for adopted catalog sessions

question: Should session-catalog providers carry authoritative owning `agentId` now, before any non-default-agent adoption path is supported?
rationale: The proposed seam is architecturally consistent but adds compatibility-sensitive plugin API surface for a latent state that current product behavior cannot reach.

options.title: Add the contract now
options.body: Add provider-authoritative `agentId`, update bundled adapters and gateway persistence, and prove both current default-agent and future cross-agent behavior.

options.title: Defer with an explicit invariant
options.body: Document and test that all catalog adoption must remain default-agent-only, then add the contract atomically with the first non-default-agent adoption feature.

recommendation.title: Add the contract now
recommendation.body: Add provider-authoritative `agentId`, update bundled adapters and gateway persistence, and prove both current default-agent and future cross-agent behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The available merged history ties this person directly to catalog adoption, conversation binding, and adopted-session upstream liveness.
